Title: Generate Azure Functions using Azure API Management extension for Visual Studio Code

Body.Content:
You can now generate Azure Functions using Azure API Management extension for Visual Studio Code. This new experimental capability can help you scaffold all the necessary functions for your API based on the API definitions. Once generated, you can add the business logic to each function as necessary. We currently support C#, Java, Python, and Type Script, with support for JavaScript and PowerShell coming in the near future.

Learn more about the release.
